assumptions: controller cannot override authority or correctness gates
value estimates are proposal/control inputs not scientific evidence
future assurance data is excluded from controller fitting
falsifier: No fresh-task utility/regret residual over strongest fixed/threshold/VOC/selector parent after controller overhead, or the controller violates any hard safety/applicability/authority gate.
minimal_counterexamples: controller spends on a field when no-field search is cheaper
retrieval is selected although current premises already suffice
myopic action has positive immediate value but prevents better later computation
controller suppresses a safety-required verification because it is costly
unknown/off-support regime routes to an unsupported specialist instead of fallback
controller compute overhead exceeds all saved downstream work
novelty_residual: Governed value-of-computation control over heterogeneous Orion mechanics beyond fixed routing, simple thresholds, generic algorithm selection, and one-step reasoning allocation.
object_description: Governed meta-controller over admissible research computations/mechanics: decide whether to retrieve, search, construct/update geometry, certify a quotient, acquire a diagnostic intervention, verify, or stop/fallback.
oracle_or_lower_bound: On bounded known worlds, exhaustively evaluate the frozen computation/action portfolio and finite-horizon action sequences to obtain oracle decision utility and regret. Any computation with expected gain no greater than its registered cost is dominated by do-nothing for that consumer under the frozen model.
permitted_publication_claim: Scoped computation/allocation policy result only; controller action never creates scientific, theorem, review-independence, or method-promotion authority.
qoi: Fresh-task decision/root utility per total computation cost and regret versus an oracle computation policy, subject to hard safety/applicability gates and an explicit do-nothing/fallback action.
same_system_ablation: Same task/action portfolio under fixed incumbent policy, analytic break-even thresholds, myopic VOC, nonmyopic VOC, robust selector, and oracle policy.
scope: Paper V-VI solver/research computations with measurable cost/outcome proxies

strongest_parents.justification: Existing frozen meta-controller/fixed rules are the incumbent control parent.
Simple break-even rules must be beaten before learning a more complex computation policy.
Direct rational metareasoning parent that trades expected reasoning value against cost.
Controls whether gains require accounting for effects of future computations rather than one-step utility.
Portfolio-selection parent controls regime prediction/generalization without explicit metareasoning semantics.

total_cost_equation: candidate_total = state/feature_estimation + controller_inference + selected_computation(s) + verification + recovery_from_failed_computation
